Trk liras cinsinden ithalat fiyatlar tahmine 2,2 puan ykseltici ynde katkda bulunurken, kt andaki gncellemeler 0,1 puan drc ynde etkilemektedir. Saygdeer Katlmclar, Jeopolitik risklerin oluturduu arz kstlar ve artan belirsizlikle kresel enflasyon yakn tarihin en yksek seviyelerini amakta ve kresel byme beklentileri hzla bozulmaktadr. Bununla birlikte, ekonomimiz salgn sonrasnda kresel ticaretteki konumunu glendirmekte ve bymemizde yatrm ve net ihracatn katksnn artyla kendini gsteren yapsal bir gelime yaanmaktadr. Bu erevede, igc piyasas gstergeleri salgn sonrasnda srekli iyileme kaydetmekte ve ekonominin istihdam oluturma kapasitesindeki art cari dengeyi kuvvetlendiren sektrler tarafndan beslenmektedir. hracat miktar ithalat miktarna gre gl bir art gstermekte, dngsel etkilerden arndrlm cari dengemiz fazlaya iaret etmektedir. Yakn dnemde cari dengemiz zerinde risk oluturan ve blgemizdeki atmalarla zirveye kan enerji ve hammadde fiyatlar enflasyonu da olumsuz etkilemektedir. Kresel ekonomi asndan srdrlebilir bulmadmz enerji fiyat seviyelerinde normalleme yaandka enflasyondaki d ve srdrlebilir cari denge hedeflerimize ulaacaz. Bu sreci liralama stratejisi erevesinde atacamz gl admlarla yrtmeye kararlyz. Konumamn son blmnde Merkez Bankasnn politika gzden geirme srecinin asli unsuru olan liralama stratejisi hakknda bilgilendirme yapacam. Liralama Stratejimizin temel hatlarna 2022 yl Ocak Enflasyon Raporunda yer vermitik. Hanehalk, firma ve banka bilanolarnda milli paramzn arlnn kalc olarak artmas ve lkemizde tek deme aracnn Trk liras olmas liralama stratejimizin nihai hedefidir. Bildiiniz gibi liralama stratejisi kapsamnda gzden geirme sreci tamamlanan bir dizi uygulamay yakn zamanda hayata geirdik. Trk liras ykmllkler iin tutulan zorunlu karlklarn sadece Trk liras ile tesisi prensibi dorultusunda, dviz cinsinden tesis edilmesi imknn sonlandrdk. Reeskont kredilerimizin net ihracat firmalar iin yalnzca belirlenen Trk liras cinsi harcama alanlarnda kullanmna izin vererek, Merkez Bankasnn fonlamas kaynakl yabanc para talebi olumamasn ve reeskont kredilerinin amacna uygun deerlendirilmesini saladk. 2021 yl Aralk aynda yabanc para ve altn mevduatlarn TLye dnmn destekleyerek, TL mevduat tercihinin glenmesi ynnde nemli bir adm attk. Bu uygulama banka bilanolarndaki TL payn artrrken fonlama vadesini uzatt. Uygulamann banka bilanolarn glendirmesi yoluyla finansal istikrara katksn net bir ekilde grmekteyiz. Liralama stratejimizin nemli bir bileeni de uygun maliyetli ve uzun vadeli kredilerin retim, yatrm ve ihracat artlaryla srdrlebilir fiyat istikrarn desteklemesidir. Uzun vadeli ve uygun maliyetli Trk liras kredilerin doru bir kompozisyonla ve tabana yaylm olarak iktisadi faaliyetle bulumas iin makroihtiyati aralarmz gl bir ekilde kullanmaya devam ediyoruz. 8 Liralama stratejisi kapsamnda gzden geirme sreci devam eden likidite ynetiminin teminat yapsna ynelik atlacak admlar teknik ekiplerimiz tarafndan tamamlanmtr. ok yakn bir dnemde Para ve Kur Politikas metnindeki yol haritamz ile uyumlu olarak fonlama yapsnda Trk liras cinsinden kymetlerin teminat olarak kullanmn ve talebini artrc ek admlarmz devreye alacaz. Dier taraftan Merkez Bankas olarak liralama kapsamnda firmalarmzn demelerini Trk liras ile yapmalarn nemsiyoruz. Para ikamesinin ve dvize endeksleme davrannn parasal aktarm verimsizletiren ve enflasyonu artran zararlarnn farknda olarak bu konuda son dnemde atlan admlar deerli buluyoruz. Salam, gl ve istikrarl Trk Lirasnn altyapsn salamak kalc fiyat istikrar hedefimize doru en ncelikli eiktir. Bir btn olarak para politikas aralarmzn etkinliini arttracak kapsaml almalar tm taraflarla birlikte yrtmekteyiz. Nihai amacmz btn ekonomik birimlerimizin her trl kararlarnda lira dnda hibir para birimine gerek duymadan Trk liras ile tasarruf yapabildikleri, tm finansal kararlarn Trk liras ile alabildikleri bir finansal mimariyi tamamlamaktr. Bu vesileyle nmzdeki gnlerde idrak edeceimiz Ramazan Bayramnz tebrik ediyor; lkemize ve tm dnyaya salk, huzur ve esenlik getirmesini Cenab- Allahtan niyaz ediyorum. imdi sizlerden gelecek sorular, sremizi de gz nnde bulundurarak alabilirim.

Title: Speech of President Murat etinkaya at the Assembly Meeting of the Istanbul Chamber of Industry
CentralBank: Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey
text: ISTANBUL CHAMBER OF INDUSTRY ASSEMBLY MEETING Murat cetinkaya 28 September 2016, Istanbul Dear Guests, Before I begin, I would like to thank Mr. President and the Istanbul Chamber of Industry for their kind invitation. As the Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey, I have previously stated on various platforms that we will strive to better understand the real sector and financial sector interactions and strengthen our communication. I consider this meeting as an important step towards concretizing the framework I have mentioned. In my speech, I will first present a brief assessment of global economic developments and their reflections on the Turkish economy. Then, I will talk about the interaction of the real sector and the financial sector, which is a topic that has recently been widely covered on a global scale. Finally, I will touch on the important role that price stability plays in this relationship. Global Outlook and Its Reflections on the Turkish Economy Dear Guests, With the economic conjuncture that emerged after the global crisis, the problems related to the trust environment and financing channels are slowing down economic growth significantly all over the world. With this process combined with falling productivity globally, weakening investments and increasing income imbalance, the world economy entered a period of slowdown. It is still not possible to get out of this period. In this period, it is more important than ever for countries to consolidate their economic foundations. In the last eight years following the global crisis, central banks have historically played crucial roles. Significant efforts were made to support the economy using all available monetary instruments; it's still being shown. However, it is now becoming clear that quantitative easing alone cannot ensure stable growth. It has been learned once again that factors such as the confidence factor, healthy financing channels and income distribution in the economy play a much more important role in the medium and long term in terms of investments and balanced growth. A strong global conviction has begun to emerge that a different approach should be adopted in economic policies; however, no consensus has yet emerged on how to do this. As the Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey, we closely follow the reflections of the developments in the global economy on the Turkish economy. The global economic conjuncture affects the economy mainly through three channels. The first is external demand, the second is capital flows, and the third is commodity and import prices. These three channels can be decisive from time to time in terms of growth, inflation and current account balance dynamics, especially for developing countries. In recent years, global liquidity conditions and low commodity prices have been relatively supportive for Turkey; however, weak global demand continues to limit exports and economic activity. Weak global demand, combined with geopolitical shocks in recent times, has led to some slowdown in economic activity. Especially in recent months, the decline in tourism revenues and the impact of the events on July 15 seem to bring about a loss of momentum in the economy in the short term. However, with the contribution of the incentives and measures taken as a result of the strong and coordinated policy response of the relevant authorities, we expect the slowdown to be temporary and the recovery to begin from the last quarter with the support of the solid foundations of the Turkish economy. We assess that the relative strength of the demand for the European Union will also support this process. As a matter of fact, recently released preliminary data indicate that the decline in industrial production observed in July will be largely temporary. 2 Undoubtedly, beyond short-term trends, the factors affecting the growth potential of the economy in the medium and long term are extremely important. From this point of view, we think that our country will be positively differentiated. Turkey's demographic structure, strong entrepreneurial base and strategic position support potential growth in the medium and long term. In addition, prudent fiscal policy, a sound banking system and a risk-oriented monetary policy framework provide significant resistance to shocks. In the recent period, it is aimed to further strengthen this solid structure with regulations that will support the increase in productivity, competitiveness and savings. Dear Guests, Within the framework of these developments, as the Central Bank, we also observe the economic balancing process by paying attention to inflation risks in order to achieve the price stability target. Accordingly, we have continued the simplification process in recent months in order to increase the effectiveness of monetary policy. The loss of momentum in the economy and the partial improvement in core inflation allowed us to achieve simplification by lowering the upper band of the corridor. However, it is necessary to emphasize again that the framework drawn by monetary policy and interest rates are only one of the components of general monetary and financial conditions. At this point, we assess that financial conditions are still tight. We made this clear in the text of our latest resolution. In the current conjuncture, it is important to understand this issue correctly in order to evaluate monetary policy decisions in a healthy way. For this reason, I would like to mention in a little more detail the cyclical and structural dimension of the concept of financial conditions. Financial Conditions Dear Guests, Recently, a significant cyclical tightness in financial conditions has emerged. When we look at the level of deposit and loan rates and credit standards, it is possible to say that this tightness continues at the point reached. When fees and commissions are included, we see that financing costs are still at high levels, especially for small and medium-sized companies. Other conditions of financing, such as maturity and collateral, are also tightening. In periods of slowdown in the economy, the tightening of financing conditions with the increase in credit risk is expected to some extent. All over the world, financial intermediaries play a role in magnifying cycles due to their structure. However, structural factors as well as cyclical reasons may play an important role in the tightness of financial conditions. Therefore, it is necessary to understand the basic dimensions of financial intermediation in order to evaluate the financing conditions in a healthy way. The conditions of access to finance can be affected by many different non-cyclical factors. For example, the business model of the financial sector and financial depth can be very important in terms of overcoming the effects of external shocks in the economy with a moderate cycle. As the Central Bank, we also attach importance to the structuring of financial intermediation and the general financial architecture in a way that softens the cycles. In this context, we think that one of the issues that need to be studied thoroughly both globally and locally in the coming period should be the interaction of the financial sector and the real sector. It is of great importance that financial intermediation is designed in a way that supports efficient production and strengthens the transmission mechanism. From this perspective, I can say that we attach importance to three basic issues related to the structural dimension of financial intermediation: The first is that financial intermediation reaches all segments of society and is distributed evenly, the second is that financing is provided at reasonable conditions and pricing, and the third is that it supports production and efficiency. As a result, the financial from our point of view 3 In terms of sector and real sector interaction, the qualitative development of the credit market has a very important place. Dear Guests, I have just mentioned the importance of regulations that increase productivity, competition and savings in terms of medium and long-term growth potential. Of course, this framework has many different dimensions, but as of our agenda today, I will approach the issue more in terms of the structural characteristics of the financial sector. Because we believe that maximizing the efficiency of the financial system will support social welfare by increasing the savings rate and competitiveness and will expand the field of action of economic policies. In order to make access to credit more efficient and healthy, diversifying financing instruments and providing financing with stable resources is also a critical issue. For all these, the deepening of capital markets is of great importance. In our country, the financial system is dominated by the banking sector. We think it would be useful to study the contributions that diversification in the financial system can bring in terms of efficiency. Price Stability, Financial Deepening and Access to Finance At this point, it is necessary to emphasize the importance of price stability once again. There is a strong two-way relationship between price stability and financial efficiency. This relationship also interacts with structural issues such as savings and dollarization. In an economy where price stability is achieved, domestic savings in domestic currency occur at longer maturities, reducing maturity mismatch and financial volatility. In addition, establishing confidence in the purchasing power of the domestic currency reduces the tendency to dollarization and can accelerate the orientation of savings to the registered system. All these factors are important for ensuring healthy and sustainable sources of financing. Price stability and macroeconomic stability are also critical for the formation of alternative funding sources. Because price stability allows healthy pricing, reduces hedging and intermediary costs and creates a favorable environment for the development of funding instruments. Less predictability of prices or the future value of an asset can increase the costs of financial intermediaries, as it will require closer examination and monitoring of fundraisers. In addition, fluctuations in inflation may adversely affect the capital structures of financial institutions under certain conditions. In periods of slowdown in economies where price stability cannot be established, financial intermediaries demand higher risk premiums, which can have an increasing effect on financing costs. In an environment of high inflation and inflation uncertainty, financial institutions would be more reluctant to meet the long-term credit demands of firms. This makes it difficult to turn savings into productive investments. In summary, price stability feeds the financial deepening and ensures the healthier functioning of financial intermediation and supports the lower intermediary costs. Thus, the support of the financial sector to production and the real sector is increased. In addition, low inflation and inflation uncertainty contribute to the fact that long-term financing costs remain at low levels. All these evaluations indicate that it is of great importance to reinforce the perception of price stability in terms of the real sector's access to finance and financial conditions. Therefore, when we look at the issue within the scope of the Central Bank's mandate, we see that the real sector is healthy in the medium and long term. 4 In a way, we can say that the most important support we can give in terms of access to finance is to achieve and maintain price stability. In this context, I would like to emphasize once again that price stability is a public value and that it should be embraced by all segments of society. I have had the opportunity to express our strategy in this regard on various platforms before. I find it useful to share the holistic approach we follow once again on this occasion. To summarize our basic approach very briefly, I can say the following: In order to achieve price stability, we strive to increase social awareness by cooperating with stakeholders in structural and strategic areas related to price stability while using the tools we have effectively. We draw attention to the importance of a joint effort of all relevant actors on this path. The work of the Food and Agricultural Products Monitoring and Evaluation Committee (Food Committee for short), which has been decided to be restructured, sets a valuable example of holistic and joint effort. Significant gains have been made so far under the said Committee, which was established to limit the negative impact of food prices on overall price stability. An important awareness was created in the public opinion regarding the structural issues related to inflation. Inter-institutional communication channels were opened and a broad-based technical cooperation was established. And finally, a very important step has been taken in the recent period in terms of taking these studies to the next stage and turning them into concrete gains. It was decided to represent the relevant institutions at the highest level in the Committee, to establish the functioning structure within the framework of a result-oriented and rule-based mechanism and to support them with a regular communication platform. We believe that this new structure and the decisions that can be taken within the scope of the Food Committee work will make a significant contribution to reducing the volatility in food prices. Undoubtedly, the concrete results of this process need to be observed in order to evaluate the medium-term reflections of the Food Committee's work in terms of price stability. However, the restructuring of the Committee should be seen as an important step in the sense that these works receive the highest level of support, joint efforts with stakeholders and represent determination to fight inflation within a holistic approach. It is necessary to say that food inflation is only one of the issues that require joint efforts regarding inflation in our country. Price stability has many structural components. In the coming period, we will be engaged in a similar effort on other issues concerning the structural dimensions of price stability. In this context, I would like to express that issues such as savings rates, financial deepening, dollarization, market competition and monetary policy, fiscal policy interaction will be mainly on our agenda. We believe that decisive steps taken on structural issues will significantly increase the effectiveness of macroeconomic policies and accelerate the process of ensuring price stability permanently. For example, taking steps to increase the predictability of managed-directed prices and their compliance with inflation targets will make a significant contribution to strengthening the perception of price stability. In addition, when it is necessary to factors that exhibit rigidity in inflation, as in the case of service prices, 5 Leaning down to micro-details is at the heart of our holistic approach to achieving price stability. We will continue to work on these issues by establishing strategic cooperation with the relevant institutions at the highest level. CBRT - Real Sector Talks Dear Guests, In the last part of the speech, I would like to briefly mention the field studies we have carried out as the central bank in order to better understand the real sector. In terms of interaction with the real sector, we have started to take very concrete steps in recent years. As the Central Bank, we regularly visit companies in different cities of our country in order to follow the current developments in the economy and strengthen our communication network with the real sector. We also have very productive meetings with many companies that are members of our Istanbul Chamber of Industry. During these visits, our Bank's managers and experts report their evaluations of the activities and expectations of the companies in order to keep their finger on the pulse of the economy, and on the other hand, they strive to identify structural problems in the sector. The results of the study constitute an important source of information about the Turkish economy for us. For example, such meetings are very useful in terms of evaluating the reflections of recent domestic developments on the economy, having timely information about the investment, production, export, employment, borrowing decisions of the real sector or understanding the effects of any regulation that concerns the sector of companies. In the next stage, we aim to share the information and inferences we have obtained from these interviews directly with decision-makers and the public and contribute to the transformation of these findings into more concrete policies. I would like to take this opportunity to thank all our companies that have agreed to meet with us and have not spared their valuable ideas and suggestions. I hope that this cooperation will be further strengthened in the coming period. The Istanbul Chamber of Industry also makes a significant contribution to our economic analysis through the publicly available data and reports it produces. For example, the published research on the first 500 and second 500 large industrial enterprises contains important information about both the indebtedness of the firm and the composition of the debt. This information allows us to make useful inferences about the indebtedness trend of companies as well as the share and maturity structure of foreign currency debts. In recent years, we have seen that our companies are shifting to longer maturities and Turkish lira in their borrowing. I find it useful to emphasize that it is important for financial stability that this trend continues and that our companies use more equity. The steps to be taken by the Central Bank towards price stability will make a significant contribution to this transformation. Dear Guests, Undoubtedly, price stability has very important effects in all dimensions that concern all segments of society; However, in my speech today, as a reflection of our meeting with the real sector, I preferred to approach the issue from the perspective of financial sector and real sector interaction. In order to emphasize our holistic approach, I wanted to underline the relationship of this issue with other important structural issues that concern our country. As a result, no matter where we look at it, it seems that the social benefits of price stability in the medium and long term are high. As the Central Bank, it is the country's goal to achieve price stability on a permanent basis. 6 We will continue our efforts to raise awareness of the economy and the benefits it will provide for all stakeholders. We remain committed to ensuring and maintaining price stability in the medium and long term in order to support sustainable macroeconomic balances and growth. In this direction, we will continue to use all our tools to the extent necessary. In addition, we will increase social awareness by continuing to produce studies on measures that can be taken in the cyclical and structural sense. We will strive to create lasting solutions and reduce trade-offs in communication with stakeholders. Our well-founded economy is expected to decompose positively in the medium and long term. As I end my speech here, I would like to express my gratitude to our Istanbul Chamber of Industry for the hospitality they have shown. Thanks for listening, regards... 7

Bu ziyaretlerde Bankamzn ynetici ve uzmanlar ekonominin nabzn tutmak amacyla bir yandan firmalarn faaliyet ve beklentilerine dair deerlendirmelerini raporlarken, dier yandan da sektrel olarak yapsal sorunlarn tespit edilmesi iin de aba gsteriyor. almadan kan sonular bizim iin Trkiye ekonomisine dair nemli bir bilgi kayna oluturuyor. rnein bu tr grmeler, yakn dnemde yurt iinde yaanan gelimelerin ekonomiye yansmalarn deerlendirmek, reel sektrn yatrm, retim, ihracat, istihdam, borlanma kararlarna ilikin zamanl bilgi sahibi olmak veya firmalar kesimini ilgilendiren herhangi bir dzenlemenin etkilerini anlamak asndan olduka faydal oluyor. Bir sonraki aamada, bu grmelerden elde ettiimiz bilgi ve karmlar dorudan karar alclarla ve kamuoyu ile paylaarak bu tespitlerin daha somut politikalara dntrlmesine katkda bulunmay amalyoruz. Bu vesileyle bizimle grme yapmay kabul ederek deerli fikir ve nerilerini esirgemeyen btn firmalarmza teekkr ediyorum. nmzdeki dnemde bu i birliinin daha da artarak glenmesini diliyorum. stanbul Sanayi Odas, rettii halka ak veriler ve raporlar araclyla da iktisadi analizlerimize nemli katk sunmakta. rnein ilk 500 ve ikinci 500 byk sanayi kuruluuna dair yaymlanan aratrmalar, hem firma borluluuna hem de bor kompozisyonuna dair nemli bilgiler ieriyor. Sz konusu bilgiler firmalarn borluluk trendinin yan sra yabanc para borlarnn payna ve vade yapsna dair faydal karmlar yapmamza olanak tanyor. Son yllarda, firmalarmzn borlanmalarnda giderek daha uzun vadeye ve Trk lirasna kaydn gryoruz. Bu eilimin devam etmesinin ve firmalarmzn daha ok zkaynak kullanmasnn finansal istikrar asndan nem arz ettiini vurgulamakta fayda gryorum. Merkez Bankasnn fiyat istikrar ynnde ataca admlar bu dnme nemli katk verecektir. Saygdeer Konuklar, Kukusuz fiyat istikrarnn toplumun btn kesimlerini ilgilendiren her boyutta olduka nemli etkileri var; ancak ben bugnk konumamda reel sektrle bulumamzn bir yansmas olarak konuya daha ok finansal sektr ve reel sektr etkileimi perspektifinden yaklamay tercih ettim. Btnsel yaklammz vurgulamak asndan bu hususun lkemizi ilgilendiren dier nemli yapsal konularla ilikisinin zellikle altn izmek istedim. Sonu olarak nereden bakarsak bakalm, fiyat istikrarnn orta ve uzun vadede toplumsal faydalarnn yksek olduu grlyor. Merkez Bankas olarak fiyat istikrarna kalc biimde ulamann lke 6 ekonomisi ve tm paydalar asndan salayaca faydalara ilikin farkndaln artrlmas iin abalarmz srdreceiz. Srdrlebilir makroekonomik dengeleri ve bymeyi de desteklemek amacyla orta ve uzun vadede fiyat istikrarn salama ve koruma ynndeki kararlmz koruyoruz. Bu dorultuda btn aralarmz gerektii lde kullanmaya devam edeceiz. Ayrca, konjonktrel ve yapsal anlamda alnabilecek tedbirlerle ilgili almalar retmeye devam ederek toplumsal farkndal artracaz. Kalc zmler retmeye ve paydalarla iletiim halinde dnleimleri azaltmaya gayret edeceiz. Salam temellere dayanan ekonomimizin orta ve uzun vadede olumlu ayrmas beklenmektedir. Title: Speech of President ahap Kavcolu at the Informative Meeting on the Introduction of "Inflation Report 2021-IV"
CentralBank: Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey
text: Prof. Dr. ahap Kavcolu, Central Bank Governor Inflation Report Briefing Meeting 2021-IV 28 October 2021, Ankara 2 Dear Members of the Press, Distinguished Participants, All of you are welcome to the last Inflation Report Information Meeting that we will hold in 2021. I would like to start my speech by sharing with you our evaluations of the inflation outlook following the global and domestic economic developments in the period since our Inflation Report Information Meeting in July. After making statements about our medium-term inflation forecasts and monetary policy strategy, I hope that we will answer the questions that will come from you and complete our meeting efficiently. Macroeconomic Outlook Despite the recovery in global economic activity in the first half of the year, the confidence indices announced in the recent period began to decline due to the impact of the pandemic. Despite the increase in vaccination rates, new variants in the outbreak are keeping alive the downside risks to global economic activity. The survival of risks related to variants has adversely affected the growth outlook in some countries and caused growth forecasts to be updated downwards. Growth forecasts have been updated downwards for some of our top export countries, especially Germany and the United States, while important trading partners such as Italy and Russia have been updated upwards. While the global PMI indices declined compared to the peak they reached, they remained above the 50 threshold level for both the manufacturing and services sectors. These developments show that Turkey's external demand outlook remains positive. When we look at the labor market, the level of employment in most of the developed countries is still below the pre-pandemic level. Although commodity prices increased on average compared to the previous Report period, the differentiation of energy and non-energy prices continues. With the increase in crude oil and natural gas prices, energy prices have accelerated recently. On the other hand, non-energy commodity prices followed a near-horizontal course due to the effect of product-based differentiations. The recovery in global demand, the high course of commodity prices, supply constraints in some sectors and the increase in transportation costs are leading to an increase in producer and consumer prices on an international scale. We see the negative reflections of the climatic conditions experienced in the main agricultural commodity exporting countries on global food prices. The effects of the rise in global inflation on inflation expectations and international financial markets are closely followed by central banks. Central banks of developed countries assess that the rise in inflation will be largely temporary with the normalization in demand composition, the easing of supply constraints and the discontinuation of base effects, but there is uncertainty about the timing of the decline in inflation. In this context, the central banks of developed countries continue their supportive monetary stance and continue their asset purchase programs. In many developing countries, both current inflation realizations and inflation expectations are above the target. However, expectations are that inflation will approach the targets by the end of 2022. 3 As a reflection of these developments in global markets, we see that portfolio flows to developing countries follow a fluctuating course. Excluding China, portfolio outflows from developing countries have recently been seen. The course of the epidemic and predictions about when and how quickly monetary policy will normalize in developed countries will continue to have an impact on portfolio movements and financial markets of developing countries in the coming period. With the effect of global inflation developments and increases in energy prices, global risk appetite followed a volatile course in the current reporting period. In the group of developing countries, including Turkey, the risk premium and implied exchange rate volatilities increased, while exchange rates lost value due to the strengthening of the dollar index. Dear Participants, I would like to continue my speech with the domestic macroeconomic outlook. In the second quarter of 2021, national income increased by 0.9 percent on a quarterly basis and by 21.7 percent on an annual basis. Although economic activity lost some momentum during this period with the pandemic restrictions and the tightening of financial conditions, it continued to stay above the long-term trend. Both domestic demand and net exports contributed to the growth in the second quarter for the period. While private consumption came to the fore in the contribution of domestic demand, public expenditures and investments remained moderate. Net exports contributed to growth, which was both strong in exports and imports declining with the slowdown in gold imports. Leading indicators show that economic activity remained strong in the third quarter of the year, driven by external demand. Industrial production continued its upward trend in July-August. Turnover indices indicate that overseas demand continued to support industrial production in the third quarter, especially in the intermediate goods and capital goods sectors. The acceleration of vaccination supports the recovery process in the global economy. With the increase in vaccination rates in Turkey and all over the world, the gradual lifting of epidemic measures emerges as a factor that increases the contribution of external demand to economic activity. On the other hand, the increase in the number of cases with the effect of the emergence of new variants of the virus causes uncertainties about the course of the epidemic to continue. The spread of vaccination to the general public allows the services sector, especially tourism, which has been adversely affected by the epidemic, to revive and to maintain economic activity with a more balanced composition. The retail sales volume index recorded a strong increase due to the impact of the opening-up. The easing of restrictions, along with the strong momentum in vaccination since June, has played a role in sharpening the recovery trend in tourism activity and related service items. While demand for durable goods slowed, a recovery was observed in non-perishable consumer goods. This stabilization in demand is important because of its positive effects on the current account balance, inflation and employment. The survey data indicates that firms plan to increase their investment expenditures for the future. The investment trends of manufacturing firms in the third quarter reached their highest value since the third quarter of 2011. In October, the increase in investment trend continued. We see this increase across companies of different scales. When we evaluate it from a sectoral point of view, we see an investment trend that spreads across the main sectors, with intermediate goods and investments being stronger. 4 If we refer to the relationship between investments and loans, we observed that the demand for loans for fixed investment by our companies also increased in the third quarter. In our PPK decisions, we stated that the tightness in the monetary stance began to have a narrowing effect on commercial loans beyond what was foreseen. With the effect of the decrease in commercial loan interest rates, loans will further support fixed capital investments in the coming period. High-frequency data on employment also point to a recovery in the labour market due to the impact of the opening-up. Services sector employment showed a slower recovery due to the impact of pandemic restrictions. However, we have seen that the losses of the epidemic period have been fully compensated with a strong employment increase here in the recent period. In addition, with the contribution of strong exports, it is noteworthy that industrial sector employment is even more positive than other sub-items. As a result, we see that non-agricultural employment has started to recover primarily with the contribution of the industrial sector, reaching pre-pandemic levels in the first quarter of 2021 despite the limited contribution from the service sector. Finally, with the opening up in the service sector and the contribution of tourism, we can say that the labor market has largely overcome the effects of the epidemic period. Exports continued their strong course in the third quarter due to the rapid recovery in global demand and the rise in export prices. The slowing effects of monetary tightening on loans and domestic demand limited import growth. Thus, despite the high increase in international commodity prices and the strong course of economic activity, imports followed a more moderate upward trend in the third quarter compared to the previous quarter. Thanks to its strong performance in exports, Turkey has become a surplus in its foreign trade with Europe, which is our largest market. In trade with the Asian region, we continue to run a deficit. While the upward trend in import prices continued due to the rise in international commodity prices in the third quarter, the increase in export prices was relatively weaker. This situation limits the reflection of the balance in foreign trade on the basis of quantity on the current account balance. On the other hand, in service revenues, the recovery has gained strength with the acceleration of vaccination and the lifting of restrictions. In the coming period, we anticipate that the improvement in the annualized current account balance will continue for the rest of the year, supported by the strong upward trend in exports due to favorable external demand conditions. The strengthening of this trend in the current account balance will be a factor that will positively affect the country's risk premium by reducing the need for external financing in the coming period. We see that the developments in the balance of payments have positive reflections on the CBRT's international reserves. Recently, a steady upward trend in reserves has been observed. In this period, especially rediscount loan returns, compulsory reserve steps and gold purchases from ore stand out as factors affecting the CBRT's reserves upwards. In addition, developments such as swap transactions with other central banks and SDR allocation were other factors that affected reserves upwards. As of October 15, 2021, the reserve figure has risen to approximately USD 126 billion. In the upcoming period, as the CBRT, we aim to continue the accumulation of reserves in order to strengthen the transmission mechanism of monetary policy. In this direction, rediscount loans come to the fore as the main reserve accumulation tool. In addition, we have recently taken various steps to increase the effectiveness of the rediscount credit mechanism. Moving on to financial conditions, the slowing effects of strong monetary tightening on loans and domestic demand continue. Annual credit growth slowed to 8.7 percent in real terms 5 marks a significant decline. However, when we look closely at the credit growth composition, we see that the tightness of the monetary stance as of the third quarter has started to have a narrowing effect on commercial loans beyond what is foreseen. Adjusted for currency effects, commercial loans grew by 6.7 percent, well below the average of previous years. In addition, the positive effects of the macroprudential policy framework strengthened by the new decisions taken in September on consumer loans and credit card expenditures began to be observed. High-frequency loan data indicate that the rate of consumer loan growth has slowed down and the maturity composition has shortened somewhat with the effect of these measures. We attach importance to the developments in commercial loans in order to support the financing of companies with high investment appetite. I would like to emphasize once again that it is important for personal loans to exhibit a more moderate and balanced growth in order to limit the risks on the inflation outlook and the external balance. Dear Members of the Press, Dear Participants, I will now briefly evaluate the inflation outlook shaped in this macroeconomic framework. Consumer inflation rose in the third quarter of the year due to increases in import prices, especially in food and energy, and supply-side factors such as disruptions in procurement processes, increases in managed/directed prices and developments related to opening-up. During this period, consumer inflation was above the forecast range presented in the July Inflation Report at 19.58 percent, while B inflation was within the forecast range at 18.63 percent. This differentiation was largely driven by the upward trend in unprocessed food prices. In the C core indicator, inflation was 16.98 percent. The annual inflation of the B index increased in the third quarter of the year compared to the previous quarter, while the annual inflation of the C index decreased slightly during the same period. In the third quarter of the year, a fluctuating course was observed in the inflation trend with the effect of closing and opening periods. In this period, the inflation trend declined in the basic goods group, while it increased in the services group due to processed food and reopening. The decisive impact of food prices on inflation dynamics remains important all over the world. Adverse weather conditions, drought, special restrictions on food exports in some countries and stock growth are causing a global rise in food prices. In this context, the central banks and policymakers of other countries are also carefully monitoring developments in food prices, core inflation developments and the impact of rising inflation on expectations. We observe this trend in food prices in Turkey as well. In July and August, food price inflation was significantly higher than both historical averages and non-food inflation. In September, unprocessed food inflation recorded some correction after high increases in the last two months, while processed food inflation was at historical averages. Annual food inflation remained high in September, although it declined to a limited extent due to the impact of fresh fruit and vegetable prices. Due to the relative weight of food in the consumption basket and the current high levels of food inflation, the contribution of food to consumer inflation is higher in our country compared to many countries. 6 Dear Participants, Before moving on to our medium-term forecasts, I think it would be useful to include our assessments of the main macro determinants of inflation. Output gap indicators monitored by the Central Bank indicate that aggregate demand strengthened following the normalization steps in the third quarter of the year. Following the pandemic measures implemented in the second quarter, restrictions were lifted in parallel with the accelerated vaccination and domestic demand revived with the realization of deferred spending. In this period, the positive course in exports continued. The increase in vaccination rates has led some countries to relax their travel restrictions to Turkey. Thus, while aggregate demand conditions received support from both sources, credit growth continued to slow due to the tight stance on monetary policy. Following the revival in the third quarter with the effect of the opening-up, we anticipate that demand conditions will follow a more moderate course in the last quarter of the year. International commodity prices continue to have an impact on producer and consumer prices. When commodity price developments were examined, the first striking point was the cessation of the increase in agricultural products in the third quarter. On the other hand, while the price increases in some basic agricultural products continued in this period, widespread increases were seen with October. While price increases in industrial metals continue, the energy subgroup has recently been negatively decoupled due to supply-demand mismatch with the recovery in global demand. Oil prices, which had fallen to historically low levels at the beginning of the pandemic, rose rapidly in 2021. We see that supply problems play a more decisive role in the recent price increase in oil prices. In addition to the increase in commodity prices, disruptions in the supply chain also cause producer prices to rise. This period sees high increases in transportation costs and longer delivery times for suppliers. This creates upward pressure on prices due to supply constraints. When we look at the supplier delivery times published within the scope of the Turkey PMI data, we see some improvement in September, although it is still below the 50 threshold value. This indicates that supply-related problems remain important, although they are decreasing. When we look at the course of inflation expectations, both the survey of market participants and market-based indicators indicate a recent increase in inflation expectations. When the inflation outlook, the course of the epidemic and the effects of the conditions specific to the epidemic period on the supply chains, the state of economic activity and demand composition and financial conditions are taken into consideration together, the need for an update in monetary policy was evaluated, and within this framework, a total of 300 basis points were reduced in the policy rate in September and October. While determining our monetary policy stance, the demand factors that monetary policy can affect, core inflation developments and analyses aimed at separating the effects of supply shocks were evaluated. In the past three months, Central Bank funding has been carried out within a simple operational framework, through open market transactions and exchange rate swap transactions. Overnight interest rates in the money market continue to form around the Central Bank policy rate. 7 Medium-Term Forecasts Dear Participants, When producing medium-term forecasts, we based our starting point on the economic outlook I have outlined so far. We have reviewed and updated our assumptions for external factors such as import prices, food prices, global growth and fiscal policy. Crude oil prices were in line with our July Inflation Report forecasts over the past period. However, the price increases that started in September and continued in October due to the supply-demand mismatch indicate that crude oil prices will remain above our July forecasts in the coming period. Therefore, our crude oil price assumptions have been updated to the upside. As you know, we make assumptions about crude oil prices by averaging the futures price curves that occur in international markets. Accordingly, we have raised our oil price assumption to an average of USD 70.8 for 2021 and to USD 77.5 for 2022. Due to the increase in oil prices as well as the rapid increase in natural gas prices in the recent period, international commodity prices have risen with the contribution of energy prices. Accordingly, assumptions about the general level of import prices were above our assumptions of the July Inflation Report due to energy prices. The forward price curve formed in international markets indicates that import prices will continue to decline after rising for a while in the coming period. We have updated our food inflation assumptions upwards for 2021 and 2022, taking into account increases in international prices and agricultural drought developments. Despite increasing uncertainties over global economic activity caused by the delta variant, there was no update in our assumptions about the external demand outlook compared to the previous Report period. We have based on a medium-term outlook in which fiscal and fiscal policies, in coordination with monetary policy, will be determined within a macro framework that is in line with the predicted path of decline in inflation. Dear Participants, I will now share with you our inflation and output gap estimates that we have produced within this general framework that I have described. In line with our basic assumptions and short-term projections, we anticipate that inflation will gradually converge to targets under an outlook in which the monetary policy stance will continue to be formed in a tight manner that will allow inflation to return to a downward trend with the disappearance of temporary effects. In this context, we estimate that inflation will be 18.4 percent at the end of 2021, will stabilize at 5 percent in the medium term after declining to 11.8 percent at the end of 2022 and 7.0 percent at the end of 2023. Thus, we raised the 2021 year-end inflation forecast by 4.3 percentage points from 14.1 percent to 18.4 percent. Updates to the assumptions of food prices and import prices in Turkish lira compared to the previous reporting period increased the inflation forecast by 2.1 points and 1.5 points, respectively. Managed/directed prices, on the other hand, increased by an estimated 0.3 percentage points, largely due to alcohol and tobacco. In addition, the update to the output gap also raised the forecast by 0.4 percentage points. 8 We also raised the 2022 year-end inflation forecast from 7.8 percent to 11.8 percent. The effects of the update in the initial conditions on the main trend of inflation increased the 2022 year-end inflation forecast by 2.2 points. On the other hand, the update in the food inflation assumption increased the forecast by 1.0 points, while the change in the output gap contributed 0.8 percentage points in the direction of the increase. Dear Guests, Before I end my speech, I would like to briefly share with you some other issues that I consider important regarding monetary policy. In the recent rise in inflation; supply-side factors such as increases in food and import prices and disruptions in procurement processes, increases in managed/directed prices and developments related to opening up were effective. Due to the reopening, we observed demand-side effects in some sectors, such as restaurants, especially in the summer months. In addition, a strong upward trend was recorded in our exports with the additional demand for our country in some sectors during the epidemic period. Currently, data on the procurement process indicate that supply-side factors remain effective on a global scale. Especially in the first period, the sudden rise in global demand was difficult to respond to the supply conditions. With the reflection of these developments, significant increases were observed in international commodity prices and freight charges. Pandemic conditions have also aggravated this outlook. We expect such restrictions to be gradually eased in the coming period. We have made an update to our monetary policy stance by evaluating the demand factors that monetary policy can affect, core inflation developments and analyses for the separation of the effects of supply shocks. However, due to supply-side incidental factors, we assess that there is limited room left until the end of the year for our downside correction in the policy rate. Finally, I would like to briefly summarize our stance on this issue by referring to the impact of climate change on central banking. The problem of global warming caused by the development of technology and rapid industrialization brings climate changes with it. Global climate changes can affect economic activity, causing fluctuations in the general price level, especially food prices, and therefore in inflation. In addition, global climate changes can adversely affect the financial system through the different financial risks it creates. As a matter of fact, global climate change is closely watched by many central banks and international financial institutions due to the risks it poses to price stability and financial stability. In this context, we observe that sustainability-themed syndicated loan supplies and eurobond asset issuances have been carried out by domestic banks and the real sector in our country recently. We assess that it is important to increase the share of sustainable-themed resources within the funding structure of domestic banks and the real sector and to realize environmentally friendly and socially themed investments in this way. In this context, as the Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey, we attach importance to supporting sustainable financial practices as a long-term policy in order to reduce the financial risks created by global climate change without causing a change in the main objectives of monetary policy. Accordingly, we continue to work on various steps such as encouraging compulsory reserve practices for these funding sources and the acceptance of sustainable-themed assets as collateral within the framework of the CBRT's liquidity management. 9 In closing, I would like to sincerely thank all our members who took part in the preparations for the report and the press conference, especially the members of the Monetary Policy Committee and the employees of our Research and Monetary Policy General Directorate. I would like to thank you again for your participation in our meeting. Also tomorrow is the 98th anniversary of our Republic. On this occasion, I congratulate you, our esteemed guests, our colleagues and our beloved nation, on the 29th October Republic Day, and I remember with respect and mercy all our martyrs and veterans, especially Gazi Mustafa Kemal Ataturk, the bani of our Republic.

Trkiyenin de iinde bulunduu gelimekte olan lkeler grubunda risk primi ve ima edilen dviz kuru oynaklklar ykselirken, dolar endeksindeki glenmenin de etkisiyle dviz kurlarnda deer kayb yaand. Saygdeer Katlmclar, Konumama yurt ii makroekonomik grnmle devam etmek istiyorum. 2021 yl ikinci eyreinde milli gelir eyreklik bazda yzde 0,9, yllk bazda ise yzde 21,7 orannda artt. ktisadi faaliyet, bu dnemde salgn kstlamalar ve finansal koullardaki sklamayla birlikte bir miktar ivme kaybetse de uzun dnem eiliminin zerinde kalmaya devam etti. kinci eyrekte dnemlik bymeye hem i talep hem de net ihracat katk verdi.  talebin katksnda zel tketim ne karken, kamu harcamalar ve yatrmlar lml seyretti. Net ihracatn bymeye verdii katkda ise gerek gl seyreden ihracat gerekse altn ithalatndaki yavalamayla gerileyen ithalat rol oynad. nc gstergeler, iktisadi faaliyetin yln nc eyreinde d talebin de etkisiyle gl seyrettiini gsteriyor. Sanayi retimi, Temmuz-Austos aylarnda ykseli eilimini srdrd. Ciro endeksleri, yurt d talebin nc eyrekte, zellikle ara mal ve sermaye mal sektrlerinde sanayi retimini desteklemeye devam ettiine iaret ediyor. Alamann hzlanmas, kresel ekonomideki toparlanma srecini destekliyor. Trkiye'de ve tm dnyada alama oranlarnn artmasyla birlikte salgn tedbirlerinin kademeli olarak kaldrlmas, d talebin iktisadi faaliyete katksn artran bir faktr olarak ortaya kyor. Dier yandan, virsn yeni varyantlarnn ortaya kmasnn da etkisiyle vaka saylarnda gzlenen art, salgnn seyrine ilikin belirsizliklerin devam etmesine neden olmaktadr. Alamann toplumun geneline yaylmas salgndan olumsuz etkilenen bata turizm olmak zere hizmetler sektrnn canlanmasna ve iktisadi faaliyetin daha dengeli bir bileimle srdrlmesine olanak tanyor. Perakende sat hacim endeksi, almann etkisiyle kuvvetli bir art kaydetti. Haziran ayndan bu yana alamadaki gl ivme ile birlikte kstlamalarn hafifletilmesi, turizm faaliyetindeki ve ilgili hizmet kalemlerindeki toparlanma eiliminin belirginlemesinde rol oynad. Dayankl tketim mallar talebi yavalarken, dayanksz tketim mallarnda bir toparlanma gzlendi. Talepteki bu dengelenme, cari ilemler dengesi, enflasyon ve istihdam zerindeki olumlu etkilerinden dolay nem arz ediyor. Anket verileri, firmalarn gelecek iin yatrm harcamalarn artrmay planladna iaret ediyor. malat sanayi firmalarnn yatrm eilimleri nc eyrekte 2011 yl nc eyreinden bu yana en yksek deerini ald. Ekim aynda da yatrm eilimindeki art srd. Bu art farkl lekteki firmalar genelinde gryoruz. Sektrel adan deerlendirdiimizde de ara mallar ve yatrmlarda daha gl olmak zere ana sektrler geneline yaylan bir yatrm eilimi gryoruz. 4 Yatrmlar ve krediler ilikisine deinecek olursak, nc eyrekte firmalarmzn sabit yatrma ynelik kredi talebinin de ykseldiini gzlemledik. PPK kararlarmzda parasal durutaki skln ticari kredilerde ngrlenin tesinde daraltc etki yapmaya baladn belirtmitik. Ticari kredi faiz oranlarndaki dn de etkisiyle nmzdeki dnemde krediler sabit sermaye yatrmlarn daha da fazla destekleyecektir. stihdama ilikin yksek frekansl veriler, almann etkisiyle igc piyasasnda da toparlanmaya iaret ediyor. Hizmetler sektr istihdam, salgna dair kstlamalarn da etkisiyle daha yava bir toparlanma sergilemiti. Ancak son dnemde burada gl bir istihdam art ile salgn dnemi kayplarnn tamamen telafi edildiini grdk. Ayrca gl giden ihracatn da katksyla, sanayi sektr istihdamnn dier alt kalemlere gre daha da olumlu seyrettii dikkat ekiyor. Sonu olarak, tarm d istihdamn ncelikle sanayi sektrnn katks ile toparlanmaya baladn, hizmet sektrnden gelen snrl katkya ramen 2021 yl ilk eyreinde salgn ncesi dzeylere ulatn gryoruz. Son olarak hizmet sektrndeki alma ve turizmin katks ile beraber igc piyasasnn salgn dnemi etkilerini byk lde atlattn syleyebiliriz. hracat, kresel talepteki hzl toparlanma ve ihracat fiyatlarndaki ykselie bal olarak nc eyrekte gl seyrini srdrd. Parasal sklatrmann krediler ve i talep zerindeki yavalatc etkileri, ithalat artn snrlad. Bylece, uluslararas emtia fiyatlarndaki yksek art ve iktisadi faaliyetin gl seyrine ramen, ithalat nc eyrekte bir nceki eyree gre daha lml bir art eilimi izledi. Trkiye, ihracatta gsterdii gl performans sayesinde en byk pazarmz olan Avrupa ile d ticaretinde fazla verir konuma gelmitir. Asya blgesi ile yaplan ticarette ise ak vermeye devam ediyoruz. nc eyrekte uluslararas emtia fiyatlarndaki ykselie bal olarak ithalat fiyatlarndaki art eilimi srerken, ihracat fiyatlarndaki art grece daha zayf seyretti. Bu durum, d ticarette miktar baznda gerekleen dengelenmenin cari ilemler dengesine yansmasn snrlyor. Dier taraftan, hizmet gelirlerinde ise alamann hzlanmas ve kstlamalarn kaldrlmasyla birlikte toparlanma g kazand. nmzdeki dnemde olumlu d talep koullarna bal olarak ihracattaki gl art eiliminin desteiyle yln geri kalannda yllklandrlm cari ilemler dengesindeki iyilemenin srmesini ngryoruz. Cari ilemler dengesindeki bu eilimin glenerek devam etmesi, nmzdeki dnemde d finansman ihtiyacn azaltarak lke risk primini olumlu etkileyecek bir unsur olacaktr. demeler dengesindeki gelimelerin TCMBnin uluslararas rezervleri zerinde olumlu yansmalarn gryoruz. Son dnemde rezervlerde istikrarl bir art eilimi gzleniyor. Bu dnemde zellikle reeskont kredi geri dnleri, zorunlu karlk admlar ve cevherden altn almlar TCMB rezervlerini yukar ynl etkileyen faktrler olarak n plana kyor. Ayrca dier merkez bankalaryla yaplan swap ilemleri ve SDR tahsisat gibi gelimeler de rezervleri yukar ynl etkileyen dier faktrler oldu. 15 Ekim 2021 tarihi itibaryla rezerv rakam yaklak 126 milyar ABD dolar seviyesine ykseldi. nmzdeki dnemde de TCMB olarak para politikasnn aktarm mekanizmasn kuvvetlendirmek amacyla rezerv birikiminin devam etmesini amalyoruz. Bu dorultuda reeskont kredileri temel rezerv biriktirme arac olarak n plana kyor. Ayrca, son dnemde reeskont kredi mekanizmasnn etkinliini artrmaya ynelik eitli admlar da attk. Finansal koullara geecek olursak, gl parasal sklatrmann krediler ve i talep zerindeki yavalatc etkileri devam ediyor. Yllk kredi bymesi yzde 8,7 seviyesine gerilerken reel olarak 5 kayda deer bir de iaret ediyor. Ancak, kredi byme kompozisyonuna yakndan baktmzda nc eyrek itibaryla parasal duruun sklnn ticari kredilerde ngrlenin tesinde daraltc etki yapmaya baladn gryoruz. Ticari krediler kur etkisinden arndrlm olarak yzde 6,7lik byme ile gemi yllar ortalamasnn olduka altnda seyrediyor. Bunun yannda, ihtiya kredileri ve kredi kart harcamalar zerinde, Eyll aynda alnan yeni kararlarla glendirilen makroihtiyati politika erevesinin olumlu etkileri gzlenmeye balad. Yksek frekansl kredi verileri, sz konusu tedbirlerin de etkisiyle ihtiya kredisi art hznn yavaladna, vade kompozisyonunun ise bir miktar ksaldna iaret ediyor. Yatrm itah yksek firmalarn finansmannn desteklenmesi iin ticari kredilerdeki gelimeleri nemsiyoruz. Bireysel kredilerin daha lml ve dengeli bir byme sergilemesinin, enflasyon grnm ve d denge zerindeki riskleri snrlamak iin nemli olduunu bir kez daha vurgulamak istiyorum. Saygdeer Basn Mensuplar, Deerli Katlmclar, imdi de bu makroekonomik erevede ekillenen enflasyon grnmn ksaca deerlendireceim. Tketici enflasyonu, yln nc eyreinde, gda ve bata enerji olmak zere ithalat fiyatlarndaki artlar ile tedarik srelerindeki aksaklklar gibi arz ynl unsurlar, ynetilen/ynlendirilen fiyatlardaki artlar ve almaya bal gelimelerin etkisiyle ykseldi. Bu dnemde, tketici enflasyonu yzde 19,58 ile Temmuz Enflasyon Raporunda sunulan tahmin aralnn zerinde, B enflasyonu ise yzde 18,63 ile tahmin aralnn iinde gerekleti. Bu farkllamada byk lde ilenmemi gda fiyatlarndaki art eilimi belirleyici oldu. C ekirdek gstergesinde ise enflasyon yzde 16,98 olarak gerekleti. B endeksinin yllk enflasyonu, yln nc eyreinde bir nceki eyree gre artarken, C endeksinin yllk enflasyonu ayn dnemde bir miktar azald. Yln nc eyreinde enflasyon eiliminde kapanma ve alma dnemlerinin de etkisiyle dalgal bir seyir gzlendi. Bu dnemde enflasyon eilimi temel mal grubunda gerilerken, ilenmi gda ve yeniden almaya bal olarak hizmet grubunda ykseldi. Gda fiyatlarnn enflasyon dinamikleri zerindeki belirleyici etkisi tm dnyada nemini koruyor. Olumsuz hava koullar, kuraklk, baz lkelerde gda ihracatna ynelik zel kstlamalar ve stok art gda fiyatlarnda kresel bir ykselie neden oluyor. Bu erevede, dier lkelerin merkez bankalar ve politika yapclar da, gda fiyatlarndaki gelimeleri, ekirdek enflasyon gelimelerini ve artan enflasyonun beklentiler zerindeki etkisini dikkatle takip ediyorlar. Gda fiyatlarndaki bu eilimi Trkiye'de de gzlemliyoruz. Temmuz ve Austos aylarnda gda fiyatlar enflasyonu gerek tarihsel ortalamalardan gerekse gda d enflasyondan belirgin olarak yksek seyretti. Eyll aynda ilenmemi gda enflasyonu son iki aydr gzlenen yksek artlar sonras bir miktar dzeltme kaydetti, ilenmi gda enflasyonu ise tarihsel ortalamalarda gerekleti. Yllk gda enflasyonu Eyll aynda taze meyve sebze fiyatlarnn etkisiyle snrl bir oranda gerilemesine karn yksek seviyesini korudu. Tketim sepeti ierisinde gdann greli arlnn fazla olmas ve gda enflasyonundaki mevcut yksek seviyeler nedeniyle, lkemizde gdann tketici enflasyonuna katks pek ok lkeye kyasla daha fazla oluyor. 6 Deerli Katlmclar, Orta vadeli tahminlerimize gemeden nce, enflasyonun temel makro belirleyicilerine ilikin deerlendirmelerimize yer vermenin faydal olacan dnyorum. Merkez Bankas bnyesinde takip edilen kt a gstergeleri yln nc eyreinde normalleme admlarn takiben toplam talebin glendiine iaret ediyor. kinci eyrekte uygulanan salgn tedbirlerinin ardndan, hzlanan alamaya paralel olarak kstlamalar kaldrld ve ertelenmi olan harcamalarn gereklemesiyle i talep canland. Bu dnemde ihracattaki olumlu seyir srd. Alama oranlarnn artmas, baz lkelerin Trkiyeye ynelik seyahat kstlamalarn gevetmesini de beraberinde getirdi. Bylece, toplam talep koullar her iki kaynaktan da destek alrken, para politikasndaki sk durua bal olarak kredi bymesi yavalamaya devam etti. Almann da etkisiyle nc eyrekteki canlanmay takiben yln son eyreinde talep koullarnn daha lml bir seyir izleyeceini ngryoruz. Uluslararas emtia fiyatlar retici ve tketici fiyatlar zerinde etkili olmaya devam ediyor. Emtia fiyat gelimeleri incelendiinde ilk dikkat eken nokta nc eyrekte tarm rnlerindeki artn durmas oldu. Dier yandan, baz temel tarmsal rnlerde fiyat artlar bu dnemde de srerken Ekim ay ile birlikte genele yaylan artlar grld. Endstriyel metallerde fiyat artlar devam ederken, kresel talepteki toparlanmayla birlikte arz-talep uyumsuzluu nedeniyle enerji alt grubu son dnemde olumsuz ayryor. Salgnn balarnda tarihsel olarak olduka dk seviyelere inen petrol fiyatlar 2021 ylnda hzl bir ekilde ykseldi. Petrol fiyatlarnda son dnemdeki fiyat artnda arz skntlarnn daha belirleyici rol oynadn gryoruz. Emtia fiyatlarndaki artn yan sra tedarik zincirindeki aksaklklar da retici fiyatlarnn ykselmesine neden oluyor. Bu dnemde tama maliyetlerinde yksek artlar grlyor ve tedarikilerin teslimat sreleri uzuyor. Bu da fiyatlar zerinde arz kstlar kaynakl yukar ynl bir bask oluturuyor. Trkiye PMI verileri kapsamnda yaymlanan tedariki teslim srelerine baktmzda, Eyll aynda, halen 50 eik deerinin altnda olmakla birlikte, bir miktar iyileme gryoruz. Bu durum, tedarik kaynakl sorunlarn azalmakla birlikte nemini koruduuna iaret ediyor. Enflasyon beklentilerinin seyrine baktmzda, hem piyasa katlmclar anketi hem de piyasa bazl gstergeler enflasyon beklentilerinde son dnemde bir miktar arta iaret ediyor. Enflasyon grnm, salgnn seyri ile salgn dnemine zg koullarn arz zincirleri zerindeki etkileri, iktisadi faaliyetin ve talep kompozisyonunun durumu ve finansal koullar birlikte dikkate alndnda para politikasnda gncelleme ihtiyac olduu deerlendirilmi, bu erevede Eyll ve Ekim aylarnda politika faizinde toplam 300 baz puan indirime gidilmitir. Para politikas duruumuzu belirlerken, para politikasnn etkileyebildii talep unsurlar, ekirdek enflasyon gelimeleri ve arz oklarnn yaratt etkilerin ayrtrlmasna ynelik analizler deerlendirilmitir. Getiimiz  aylk dnemde Merkez Bankas fonlamas sade bir operasyonel erevede, ak piyasa ilemleri ve kur takas ilemleri kanalyla yaplmtr. Para piyasasndaki gecelik faizler Merkez Bankas politika faizi etrafnda olumaya devam etmektedir. 7 Orta Vadeli Tahminler Deerli Katlmclar, Orta vadeli tahminler retilirken, balang noktas olarak imdiye kadar zetlediim iktisadi grnm esas aldk. thalat fiyatlar, gda fiyatlar, kresel byme ve maliye politikas gibi dsal unsurlar iin varsaymlarmz gzden geirdik ve gncelledik. Ham petrol fiyatlar, getiimiz dnemde Temmuz Enflasyon Raporu tahminlerimizle byk lde uyumlu olarak gerekleti. Ancak, arz-talep uyumsuzluuna bal olarak Eyll aynda balayp Ekim aynda da devam eden fiyat artlar, ham petrol fiyatlarnn nmzdeki dnemde Temmuz ay tahminlerimizin zerinde kalacana iaret ediyor. Bu nedenle, ham petrol fiyat varsaymlarmz yukar ynl gncellendi. Bildiiniz gibi, ham petrol fiyatlarna dair varsaymlarmz uluslararas piyasalarda oluan vadeli fiyat erilerinin ortalamasn alarak oluturuyoruz. Buna gre, petrol fiyat varsaymmz 2021 yl iin ortalama 70,8 ABD dolarna, 2022 yl iin ise 77,5 ABD dolarna ykselttik. Petrol fiyatlarndaki artn yan sra doal gaz fiyatlarnn da son dnemde hzl bir ekilde artmasna bal olarak uluslararas emtia fiyatlar enerji fiyatlarnn katksyla ykseldi. Bu dorultuda, ithalat fiyatlarnn genel seviyesine ilikin varsaymlar da enerji fiyatlar kaynakl olarak Temmuz Enflasyon Raporu varsaymlarmzn zerinde kald. Uluslararas piyasalarda oluan vadeli fiyat erisi nmzdeki dnemde ithalat fiyatlarnn bir sre daha ykseldikten sonra de geeceine iaret etmektedir. Gda enflasyonu varsaymlarmz uluslararas fiyatlarda gzlenen artlar ve tarmsal kuraklk gelimelerini dikkate alarak 2021 ve 2022 yllar iin yukar ynl gncelledik. Kresel iktisadi faaliyet zerinde delta varyant kaynakl belirsizliklerin artmasna ramen, d talep grnmne ilikin varsaymlarmzda, getiimiz Rapor dnemine gre bir gncelleme olmad. Maliye politikas ve finansal politikalarn, para politikas ile egdm ierisinde, enflasyonda ngrlen d patikasyla uyumlu bir makro erevede belirlenecei bir orta vadeli grnm esas aldk. Deerli Katlmclar, imdi sizlerle, anlattm bu genel ereve dhilinde rettiimiz enflasyon ve kt a tahminlerimizi paylaacam. Temel varsaymlarmz ve ksa vadeli ngrlerimiz dorultusunda, para politikas duruunun, geici etkilerin ortadan kalkmasyla enflasyonun yeniden d eilimine dnmesini salayacak sklkta oluturulmaya devam edilecei bir grnm altnda enflasyonun kademeli olarak hedeflere yaknsayacan ngryoruz. Bu erevede, enflasyonun 2021 yl sonunda yzde 18,4 olarak gerekleeceini, 2022 yl sonunda yzde 11,8e ve 2023 yl sonunda ise yzde 7,0 seviyesine geriledikten sonra orta vadede yzde 5 dzeyinde istikrar kazanacan tahmin ediyoruz. Bylece, 2021 yl sonu enflasyon tahminini 4,3 puanlk gncellemeyle yzde 14,1den yzde 18,4e ykselttik. Bir nceki Rapor dnemine gre gda fiyatlar ve Trk liras cinsinden ithalat fiyatlar varsaymlarndaki gncellemeler, enflasyon tahminini srasyla 2,1 puan ve 1,5 puan artrd. Ynetilen/ynlendirilen fiyatlar ise, byk lde alkol-ttn kaynakl olarak tahmini 0,3 puan ykseltti. Ayrca, kt andaki gncelleme de tahmini 0,4 puan yukar ekti. 8 2022 yl sonu enflasyon tahminini de yzde 7,8den yzde 11,8e ykselttik. Balang koullarndaki gncellemenin enflasyonun ana eilimine etkileri, 2022 yl sonu enflasyon tahminini 2,2 puan artrd. Dier yandan, gda enflasyonu varsaymndaki gncelleme tahmini 1,0 puan artrrken, kt andaki deiiklik ise 0,8 puan ykseltici ynde katkda bulundu. Kymetli Misafirler, Konumam bitirmeden nce, para politikasna ynelik nemli grdm dier baz hususlar sizlerle ksaca paylamak istiyorum. Enflasyonda son dnemde gzlenen ykselite; gda ve ithalat fiyatlarndaki artlar ile tedarik srelerindeki aksaklklar gibi arz ynl unsurlar, ynetilen/ynlendirilen fiyatlardaki artlar ve almaya bal gelimeler etkili oldu. Yeniden almaya bal olarak bilhassa yaz aylarnda lokantaotel gibi baz sektrlerde talep ynl etkiler gzlemledik. Ayrca, salgn dneminde baz sektrlerde lkemize olan ek taleple ihracatmzda gl art eilimi kaydedildi. Hlihazrda tedarik srecine ynelik veriler kresel lekte arz ynl unsurlarn etkisini koruduuna iaret ediyor. zellikle ilk dnemde kresel talepte kaydedilen ani ykselie, arz koullar karlk vermekte zorland. Bu gelimelerin de yansmasyla uluslararas emtia fiyatlarnda ve navlun cretlerinde kayda deer artlar izlendi. Salgn koullar da bu grnm arlatrd. Bu tr kstlarn nmzdeki dnemde kademeli olarak hafiflemesini bekliyoruz. Para politikasnn etkileyebildii talep unsurlarn, ekirdek enflasyon gelimelerini ve arz oklarnn yaratt etkilerin ayrtrlmasna ynelik analizleri deerlendirerek para politikas duruumuzda bir gncelleme yaptk. Bununla birlikte, arz ynl arzi unsurlardan kaynakl olarak politika faizinde yaptmz aa ynl dzeltme iin yl sonuna kadar snrl bir alan kaldn deerlendiriyoruz. Son olarak, iklim deiikliinin merkez bankaclna etkisine deinerek bizim bu konudaki duruumuzu ksaca zetlemek istiyorum. Teknolojinin geliimi ve hzl sanayilemenin yol at kresel snma sorunu iklim deiikliklerini de beraberinde getiriyor. Kresel iklim deiiklikleri iktisadi faaliyeti etkileyerek, bata gda fiyatlar olmak zere genel fiyat dzeyinde ve dolaysyla enflasyonda dalgalanmaya neden olabiliyor. Ayrca, kresel iklim deiiklikleri yaratt farkl finansal riskler araclyla finansal sistemi de olumsuz etkileyebiliyor. Nitekim kresel iklim deiiklii, fiyat istikrar ve finansal istikrara dair yaratt riskler nedeniyle pek ok merkez bankas ve uluslararas finansal kurulu tarafndan yakndan izleniyor. Bu kapsamda, son dnemde lkemizde de yurt ii bankalar ve reel sektr tarafndan da srdrlebilirlik temal sendikasyon kredi temini ve eurobond kymet ihralarnn gerekletirildiini gzlemliyoruz. Yurt ii bankalar ve reel sektrn fonlama yaps ierisinde srdrlebilir temal kaynaklarn paynn artmasnn ve bu ekilde evre dostu ve sosyal temal yatrmlarn gerekletirilmesinin nemli olduunu deerlendiriyoruz. Bu erevede, Trkiye Cumhuriyet Merkez Bankas olarak para politikasnn ana hedeflerinde bir deiiklie yol amadan, kresel iklim deiikliinin yaratt finansal riskleri azaltmak amacyla srdrlebilir finans uygulamalarn uzun vadeli bir politika olarak desteklemeyi nemsiyoruz. Bu dorultuda sz konusu fonlama kaynaklarna dair tevik edici zorunlu karlk uygulamalar, srdrlebilir temal kymetlerin TCMB likidite ynetimi erevesinde teminat olarak kabul edilmesi gibi eitli admlara dair almalarmz srdryoruz. 9 Konumam sonlandrrken bata Para Politikas Kurulu yeleri ve Aratrma ve Para Politikas Genel Mdrlmz alanlar olmak zere Rapor ve basn toplantsyla ilgili hazrlklarda grev alan tm mensuplarmza da gnlden teekkr ediyorum. Toplantmza katlmnzdan dolay da sizlere tekrar teekkrlerimi sunuyorum. Ayrca yarn Cumhuriyetimizin 98. yl dnm. Bu vesileyle, siz deerli misafirlerimiz, alma arkadalarmz ve aziz milletimizin 29 Ekim Cumhuriyet Bayramn tebrik ediyor, Cumhuriyetimizin banisi Gazi Mustafa Kemal Atatrk bata olmak zere tm ehit ve gazilerimizi saygyla, rahmetle yd ediyorum.

Title: Speech of President Ba at the Informative Meeting on the Introduction of the "Inflation Report 2014-II"
CentralBank: Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey
text: 2014 APRIL INFLATION REPORT INFORMATION MEETING Erdem BACI 30 April 2014, Istanbul Dear Guests, Welcome to the informative meeting where we will share the main messages of the April 2014 Inflation Report with you. I would like to present to you an overview of the Report, which will be published on our website in a moment. In the Report, as always, we share our assessments of macroeconomic developments with the economic outlook that form the basis for monetary policy decisions and present our medium-term inflation forecasts and monetary policy stance updated in line with the developments in the last three months. In addition, in addition to the main sections in the Report, we have included four boxes on various topics. These boxes contain analyses of current and interesting topics. For example, the Report has a box that shows the level of the yield curve as well as the effect of its slope on exchange rates. There are also boxes on updates on construction investment expenditures, the impact of the Fed's exit policy from quantitative easing on capital flows, and the foreign currency indebtedness and exchange rate risk of companies in Turkey. You see the titles of the boxes on the mirror. Each of them sheds light on important issues related to the Turkish economy. As you know, in the last quarter of 2013, the driving force of growth in global economic activity was the economies of developed countries. Title: Speech of Chairman Murat etinkaya at the Informative Meeting on the Introduction of "Inflation Report 2017-I"
CentralBank: Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey
text: 2017 JANUARY INFLATION REPORT INFORMATION MEETING Murat cetinkaya 31 January 2017, Ankara Dear Guests, Welcome to the informative meeting where we will share the main messages of the January 2017 Inflation Report with you. In the report, we share our assessments of the economic outlook and macroeconomic developments that form the basis for monetary policy decisions and present our medium-term inflation forecasts and monetary policy stance updated in line with the developments in the last three months. In addition to the main sections of the report, we included eight boxes on various topics. These studies include analyses of current issues. In the report, examining the reasons for the increase in global uncertainties in the recent period and their possible reflections on developing countries; There are boxes on the CPI and its subgroups that analyze the exchange rate and import price transitivity using detailed price indices and evaluate the 2016 year-end inflation forecasts. In addition, there are studies that introduce the calculated economic uncertainty indicator for Turkey, look at the output gap with alternative indicators, examine the connection between the real foreign trade deficit and credit growth, and analyze the sensitivity of the public spending multiplier to business cycles in Turkey. You see the titles of the boxes on the mirror. Each sheds light on important issues related to the Turkish economy that are already at the center of current debates. Dear Guests, I will begin by referring to the global economic outlook, which continues to play an important role in our policies. As you have been following closely, uncertainties about the global economy continued to increase after the US elections in November 2016. Expectations that growth will gain momentum with supportive fiscal policy in the US and that the Fed will tighten monetary policy faster than predicted have strengthened. Depending on these developments, there were increases in developed country interest rates in the last quarter of the year and the US dollar appreciated (Chart 1). These developments have led to the shift of capital flows from developing countries to developed countries since November (Chart 2). 2 Figure 1. 10-Year Bond Yields (Percent) Germany 3,5 ABD England 3,0 Japan 2,5 2,0 1,5 1,0 0,5 0,0 -0,5 Figure 2. When we look at the domestic economic outlook, in addition to the volatility in global markets, geopolitical developments and uncertainties caused domestic financial markets to follow a volatile course in the fourth quarter of 2016. Turkey has decoupled negatively from other developing countries in exchange rate and market interest rates. In this period, as in other developing countries, there were portfolio outflows from Turkey and the outflows in the bond market were more pronounced than in the stock market. Thanks to macroprudential policies supporting the financial system, the delayed effects of the liquidity measures taken by the Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey (CBRT) and public incentives, we have observed a recovery trend in the use of credit in recent months. In the last quarter of 2016, the moderate increase in credit growth continued, driven by a revival in consumer loans and Turkish lira-denominated commercial loans. In addition, thanks to public credit supports for enterprises, the loan rates applied by banks to small and medium-sized enterprises also tended to fall. At the end of 2016, consumer inflation increased by 8.53 percent compared to the previous quarter due to the depreciation of the Turkish lira, tax adjustments and the partial rise in food prices. While economic activity contracted on a quarterly basis in the third quarter of the year in line with the outlook we outlined in the October Inflation Report, current indicators point to a moderate recovery in the main trend in the fourth quarter. Domestic demand remains relatively weak, but the increase in demand from European Union countries continues to have a positive impact on exports. With the contribution of the supportive incentives and measures taken, we expect the trend of moderate recovery in economic activity to continue. On the current balance side, the positive impact of commodity prices will gradually decrease in the coming periods. 3 however, we assess that the recovery will continue with the recovery in net goods exports. 1. Monetary Policy Practices and Monetary Conditions Dear Guests, In 2016, we maintained our policy stance against the inflation outlook, stabilizing currency liquidity and supporting financial stability. In the period between March and September 2016, we continued the process of simplification in monetary policy. Accordingly, we reduced the upper band of the corridor by a total of 250 basis points by taking measured and cautious steps during the period March-September 2016. By October 2016, the slowdown in aggregate demand supported the gradual decline in core inflation, but developments in the exchange rate and other cost elements limited the improvement in the inflation outlook and necessitated the maintenance of a cautious stance in monetary policy. Against this backdrop, we kept policy interest rates steady in October. In order to prevent exchange rate movements due to the increase in global uncertainties and high volatilities in November from distorting inflation expectations and pricing behavior, we carried out some monetary tightening and raised the marginal funding rate by 25 basis points and the one-week repo auction rate by 50 basis points (Chart 3). In December, we did not change interest rates, assessing that it would be useful to monitor the extent to which aggregate demand developments would limit the upside risks on the inflation outlook. 0616 0716 0716 0816 0916 1016 1116 1216 0117 0616 0716 0716 0816 0916 1016 1116 1216 0117 Figure 3.
